ev_0004.summary: Triangle-like figure. Labelled points A (top-left), B (top-right), C (bottom-right), D (bottom-left), F (interior foot-like point on AD), E (crossing of AC and BD). Paths: A-B horizontal top segment; B-E-D straight diagonal through E (solid); A-E-C straight segment (solid); D-C horizontal bottom segment; A-F-D left side (solid); F-E horizontal solid segment ending at E. All strokes solid, no dashed segments. No right-angle marks visible in the raster, so angle_marks is empty. No perpendicular feet drawn.

payload.notes: Generate mode. Used the program-owned CV coordinates (A–F) by name and did not redefine them; the program inserts that block at the start of the tikzpicture, so the file compiles only with that insertion. Stroke width 1.3pt with line join=round and label font 13.5/16.2 pt from STYLE METRICS. All strokes solid, no dashes. Edges drawn as named polylines: B–E–D, A–E–C, A–F–D, plus AB, DC, FE. No right-angle marks (none verified). Label placements follow the source offsets. Measurement check: E lies about 0.6 px off the straight line AC (computed y≈310.75 vs measured 310.16), which is within noise, so the A–E–C chain is kept as a polyline. Nothing was remeasured or moved.
